metadata.title: Hamiltonian stationary Lagrangian surfaces in complex space forms with constant-length gradient of the mean curvature
metadata.abstract: We study Hamiltonian stationary Lagrangian surfaces in complex space forms with nowhere-zero mean curvature vector $H$. We prove that if the Gaussian curvature is constant and $\grad|H|$ has positive constant length, then both the surface and the ambient space are flat. Moreover, the immersion is locally congruent to the known surface obtained as the product of a Cornu spiral and its reflection.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 对平均曲率向量处处非零、Gauss 曲率恒定且 |H| 梯度长度为正常数的 Hamiltonian stationary Lagrangian 曲面，证明环境与曲面均平坦，并给局部分类。
analysis.breakthrough: 在强几何约束下把曲面约化为已知平面模型的乘积。
analysis.limitations: 多项恒定性和非零条件关键，不能推广为一般 Hamiltonian stationary 曲面的分类。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
